fullPassage: (A) One day, a sage was traveling with his disciple through the capital of a prosperous kingdom. As they walked along a busy road, the sage noticed a coin on the ground. Since he lived simply and had no need for it, he told his disciple he hoped to give it to someone who truly required it. The two men searched the streets, but found no one in genuine need of the coin. (B) The king, puzzled and slightly annoyed at what he did, asked, "What is the meaning of this coin? I am the richest king in the land. Why would I need a single coin?" The sage replied calmly, "Oh, Great King, I found this coin yesterday while walking through your capital. I had no need for it, so I planned to give it to someone who did. Yet everyone I met seemed content and lacked any urgent need." (C) The next morning, near the palace, they saw the king preparing for a war. The king was not satisfied with what he had and sought to expand his kingdom. Accompanied by his army, he stopped when he saw the sage and his disciple. He approached the sage and asked for a blessing that might ensure victory. After a quiet moment of thought, the sage handed the king the coin he had found the previous day. (D) The sage added, "Today, I see you preparing for war, seeking to conquer more. And I thought you, the one who desires more, were in need of this coin." The king was struck by the sage's words. He realized that his hunger for more had made him forget the value of contentment. The sage's simple but powerful lesson made him change his plans. The king called off the invasion and chose to appreciate what he already had.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 현자는 제자(disciple)와 번영하는(prosperous) 왕국을 여행하며, 동전이 진정으로 필요한(required) 사람에게 주려 했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① disciple — prosperous — required: 원문 일치

questions.passage: The king was not (A) with what he had and sought to expand his kingdom. After a quiet moment of thought, the sage (B) the king the coin. The king was struck by the sage's words and realized his hunger for more had made him forget the value of (C).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 왕은 가진 것에 만족하지 못했고(satisfied), 현자는 동전을 건넸으며(handed), 왕은 만족(contentment)의 가치를 잊었음을 깨달았다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① satisfied — handed — contentment: 원문 일치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 왕은 자신의 왕국을 확장하려(expand) 했다. ③ reduce(축소하다)는 expand의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ reduce(축소하다): 원문은 expand(확장하다)
✅ ② genuine(진정한): 원문 일치

questions.passage: The king, ①<u>puzzled</u> and slightly annoyed at what he did, asked the meaning of the coin. The sage replied ②<u>calmly</u> that everyone seemed ③<u>content</u> and lacked any urgent need. The king was struck by the sage's words and realized his hunger for more had made him forget the value of ④<u>ambition</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 왕은 만족(contentment)의 가치를 잊었다. ④ ambition(야망)은 contentment의 반대 맥락으로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ ambition(야망): 원문은 contentment(만족)
✅ ③ content(만족한): 원문 일치
